{{Top}}
'''Blue Eleven''' was the callsign of the eleventh member of [[Blue Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Blue Eleven.

*[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]
